info.title: Agentic Sentiment Intelligence API
info.description: Customer feedback analysis and sentiment intelligence API

get.description: Process liveness only; no authentication or provider call.

post.description: Classify feedback. Urgency is suggested triage, not a verified safety assessment.
Answer a bounded question using at most ten request-supplied records.
Use an explicit mode and current feedback; no chat history is retained.

schema.title: Response Report Api V1 Batch Jobs  Job Id  Report Get

get.summary: Download completed report and results as JSON

schema.title: Response Download Api V1 Batch Jobs  Job Id  Download Get

evidence_limit.title: Evidence Limit
evidence_limit.description: Number of source records to return, from 1 to 10.

ActionSelection.title: ActionSelection
ActionSelection.description: All provider fields are required; null represents an unused filter.

name.title: Name
name.description: Lowercase snake_case name, at most 64 characters.

Aspect.title: Aspect
Aspect.description: An important feedback aspect with a normalized snake_case name.

ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest
ChatRequest.description: Every request contains its own feedback; history and identity fields are rejected.

ChatResponse.title: ChatResponse
ChatResponse.description: One typed envelope with exactly one populated result and explicit limitations.

InvestigationResponse.title: InvestigationResponse
InvestigationResponse.description: Observed classifications are distinct from tentative recommendations.

SentimentRequest.title: SentimentRequest
SentimentRequest.description: Feedback and allowlisted context hints; no tenant identity is accepted.

urgency.description: Suggested triage level, not a verified safety or risk assessment.

aspects.title: Aspects
aspects.description: At most 20 important aspects; empty when none can be identified.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Concise factual summary, at most 1000 characters.

suggested_next_step.title: Suggested Next Step
suggested_next_step.description: A recommendation, not an action taken; at most 1000 characters.

evidence_phrases.title: Evidence Phrases
evidence_phrases.description: At most 20 exact, nonblank substrings of the original feedback.

SentimentResponse.title: SentimentResponse
SentimentResponse.description: Validated classification; urgency is suggested triage, not a safety assessment.

DevelopmentAPIKey.description: Single development API key; this does not provide tenant isolation.
DevelopmentAPIKey.name: X-API-Key

FeedbackHMAC.description: HMAC-SHA256 over integration.timestamp.delivery.original_body; all four signed headers are required. See docs/WEBHOOK_INTEGRATION.md.
FeedbackHMAC.name: X-Feedback-Signature
